verdict.rationale: Figma's core marketing/docs explicitly describe multiplayer files with live cursors and shared collaborative space, matching the story directly ([figma-docs-14], [figma-docs-27], [figma-docs-51]). Community commentary corroborates Figma's strength as a collaborative, feature-rich design tool rather than disputing real-time sync ([figma-comm-6]). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of live-cursor sync at scale (e.g., large team files) and no mention of sync-conflict edge cases.
